heading.title: Frequently asked questions
heading.subtitle: Everything you need to know about building and managing surveys.

1.title: What is SurveyLand?
1.text: SurveyLand is a survey and feedback platform designed to help teams collect opinions, understand trends, and take action faster.

2.title: Can I create custom surveys?
2.text: Yes. You can build custom surveys with multiple question types, logic, and design options.

3.title: Is it easy to share surveys?
3.text: Absolutely. Share by link, email, or embed surveys directly in your workflow.

4.title: Can I track responses?
4.text: Yes. Each response is tracked in real time, with dashboards and reporting for your team.

5.title: Do you support team collaboration?
5.text: Yes. Teams can review responses and collaborate on decisions in one place.

6.title: Can I use templates?
6.text: You can start with ready-made templates and customize them to fit your needs.

7.title: What kind of questions can I use?
7.text: You can use multiple-choice, short answer, long answer, ranking, and other survey formats.

8.title: Is there a pricing plan?
8.text: Yes. We offer flexible plans for individuals, teams, and growing businesses.

9.title: Do you offer customer support?
9.text: Yes. Our support team helps you get started and resolve issues quickly.

10.title: Need more help?
10.text1: You can reach our support team or explore our pricing options.
